verdict.rationale: Netlify's official CLI is documented to 'run local dev servers', and a community user confirms Netlify Dev exists, though they hit an error over unclear netlify.toml [dev] configuration docs. Nothing in the evidence shows the local environment emulates the production runtime (functions, edge, redirects, env vars) with parity. missing for 10: documented production-runtime parity of the local simulator, local emulation of serverless/edge functions and platform features, clear dev configuration docs, independent hands-on confirmation that local matches production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
